card.name: The digit 2 inside parentheses
card.fires_on: The digit 2 when it appears right after an opening parenthesis or at the start of a number. Typical settings are small counts or percentages in lists, and section cross-references such as 'Dosage and Administration (2.1)'.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: The digit 2 opens a section number in a bracketed 'see Dosage and Administration' reference.

modes.label: Counts and percentages in lists
modes.description: The digit 2 is a small count or percent in parentheses after a state or adverse reaction name.

card.plain: It lights up on the number 2 when it starts a number in parentheses, such as a section reference or a small percentage in a list.
